title: Business Unit Controller (m/f/d)
description: Search Criteria Loading... Apply now » Apply now Apply Now Start Please wait... Business Unit Controller (m/f/d) Meitingen is SGL Carbon's largest location worldwide. Meitingen is home to all our three SGL business units as well as individual central functions and thus offers a wide range of opportunities for your professional development. Your Opportunity: In this role, you will shape financial transparency, performance steering and value creation across the organization. As a trusted partner to management, you will turn financial and operational insights into clear recommendations. Lead financial controlling, reporting, budgeting and forecasting for the Business Unit  (BU) Fiber Composites across its 5 Business Lines and 7 sites, ensuring consistent financial transparency towards BU Management and the Board of Management Manage profitability and cash flow, coordinate the global BU finance community against defined targets and drive continuous improvement of forecasting, working capital, CAPEX and OPEX processes Coordinate monthly performance reviews and provide focused KPI reporting to the BU Management and local management, while streamlining reporting processes to improve efficiency in strong collaboration with Corporate Functions (Accounting, Tax, Treasury, etc.) Act as a trusted Business Partner by challenging business assumptions, translating financial and operational developments into actionable recommendations and ensuring that relevant risks are reflected in forecasts, plans and management discussions Support investment and strategic decisions through robust business cases, scenario analyses and risk management assessments Steer relevant spend areas through analysis, target setting, initiative definition and KPI tracking in cooperation with the Global Procurement Organization Leading strategic projects in the BU, e.g., M&A projects, significant growth CAPEX projects Generation of updated or new business strategies in close alignment with Head of BU FC Your Profile: University degree in finance or business administration, MBA or a comparable qualification with a focus on controlling and finance At least eight years of managerial and/or operational experience in an international environment Strong leadership and communication skills in a global, matrix-based and team-oriented environment Proven entrepreneurial, proactive behavior and hands-on mentality as well as proven experience in leading change Excellent analytical, problem-solving as well as project management skills in a complex industrial environment Advanced knowledge of SAP R/3 and BW, as well as solid IFRS knowledge Excellent communication skills in German and English We offer: Mobile working Flexible working time models and 30 days' holiday Company pension scheme Bicycle leasing Exclusive employee discounts (corporate benefits) Staff canteen Free parking Professional and private accident insurance Company medical care and offers such as flu vaccinations Our promise: Your personal contribution is crucial to our success. With us, you'll find opportunities for both personal and professional growth. Together, we will foster a culture where values-based interactions are just as important as performance and results. As a leader, you will help create a working environment where leading people with passion creates value and motivation! Be part of our leadership team! As one of the world's leading companies in developing and manufacturing specialty graphite, carbon fibers, and composite materials, we create innovative solutions for today's major challenges: mobility, energy, and digitalization. With around 3,800 employees across 28 sites worldwide, we are dedicated to shaping the future through our products and technologies. Our work not only advances industry but also benefits society and reduces environmental impact. Join us, lead with passion and make a difference! We strongly encourage all qualified applicants to apply, regardless of gender, age, disability, origin, religion, or sexual orientation.
